items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: I would say Ray Nance in the later years with Duke

ctx.x: I would say Ray Nance in the later years with Duke, then before Ray Nance was a guy named Freddie Jenkins. He was with Duke. And they would do funny things you know, in the band. Those would be my two greatest ones I think. We had Ray and Freddie. Ray Nance’d be laughing all night.
And I would like to ask you if you have a final anecdote you’d like to leave us with.
